snippet.title: Rhythm Thief R: Emperor Napoleon's Legacy - Opening (Clair De Lune - Miwa)
snippet.description:
no this isn't the new video

This is the intro sequence for the Japanese version of the game Rhythm Thief & the Emperor's Treasure.
The opening song is "Clair De Lune" by Miwa. (https://youtu.be/MsVhXBMZlFk)
The entire opening sequence was cut from the Western release, I get maybe replacing the song with the game's theme or whatever, but cutting the entire thing is kinda lame. -_-
I couldn't find any uploads on YouTube, so I figured I'd do so myself.
Captured using Citra. (Citra's really bad with FMV's so this took forever to get at normal speed.)

I don't own anything.
Rhythm Thief & the Emperor's Treasure © Sega
